name: Snap Store Linux application catalogue
description: Official Snap Store catalogue and installation guidance for Linux distributions that support Snap packages.
license_note: Snaps have individual publishers, licences and permissions. Review the package publisher and confinement information before installation.
notes: Install snapd only using instructions for the target distribution.
Check publisher and permissions for each Snap.
Snap packages are not interchangeable with DEB, RPM, Flatpak or Windows installers.
